name: Wonderfest
blurb: A scale-model and hobby expo in Louisville with a model contest, the Rondo Hatton Classic Horror Awards, and sci-fi/horror guests, running since 1992.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown and text: 'Next ‘Fest: June 5-6, 2027 | Crowne Plaza Louisville Hotel'

notes: The guests page (and homepage 'MEET THE 2026 GUESTS' heading) still shows the lineup for the already-passed 2026 show (Ve Neill, Barbara Luna, Greg Nicotero, etc.); a separate nav link points to '/speaker/guests-tba/' for the 2027 show, so 2027 guests are not yet announced. No official og/twitter image; used the wide 2027 slider banner (file name '2027-wide-slider2.png') as cover instead of the generic 2015 background photos.
